newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX win wireless licenses.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, NYNEX win wireless licenses.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp and NYNEX Corp said Tuesday they won new Wireless Communications Service (WCS) licenses in bids valued at $1.6 million.

The licenses are for 10 megahertz (MHz) of WCS spectrum in the 2.3 gighertz (GHz) range, covering a total population of 67.3 million. The companies said the new WCS spectrum is above the 1.9 GHz band for Personal Communications Services (PCS) and the 850 MHz band used for cellular services.
The companies said the licenses cover areas stretching across nearly their entire combined territories.
